name: docket
description: One list every AI tool you use can write to — scoped per project, local-first, self-hostable.
long_description: Docket is a shared todo list and backlog that Claude, Codex, Cursor and any other MCP host can all write to. Items are filed under the project they were captured in, automatically, from the git remote of wherever the agent runs. A web dashboard starts on http://localhost:8787 the first time an agent connects. Everything stays on this machine unless you point it at your own self-hosted server.

tools.name: todo_add
tools.description: Capture work the moment it comes up, from any tool or project

tools.name: todo_list
tools.description: What's open in this project (or every project)

tools.name: todo_edit
tools.description: Edit an item's title, description, category, priority, due date, source link or list

tools.name: todo_claim
tools.description: Mark an item as being worked on by the calling agent

tools.name: todo_release
tools.description: Clear the in-progress claim without completing the item

tools.name: todo_history
tools.description: Who changed an item, how, and when

tools.name: todo_version
tools.description: Data format version and start time of this docket process

tools.name: todo_check_update
tools.description: Check npm for a newer docket

data_dir.title: Data directory
data_dir.description: Where the list is stored. Use the same directory in every tool that should share it.
